title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
tagline: Shrink the snacks. Supersize the mains.
about: Scott Lang, stuck on house arrest, teams up with Hope and Hank to rescue Janet from the quantum realm.
cue: Serve the snacks when Scott does magic tricks for Cassie under house arrest.
